headline: Paraguay Lawmakers Seek Impeachment of President Peña Over Bank Crisis
summary: Opposition lawmakers in Paraguay introduced an impeachment motion against President Santiago Peña. The action follows a state intervention into digital lender Ueno, which left customers unable to access funds.
why: Sovereign political instability and executive impeachment proceedings create domestic market volatility and disrupt capital inflows in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Impeachment proceedings introduce governance uncertainty following a domestic banking intervention.
